laws.name: New York Paid Sick Leave Law
laws.description: Requires employers to provide paid sick leave. Employers with 4+ employees must provide at least 5 days/40 hours per year.

other_requirements: Covers employee's own illness, preventive care, or family member illness

laws.notes: Applies to private employers with 4+ employees. Can be used for diagnosis, care, or treatment of existing health condition.

laws.name: New York Paid Family Leave
laws.statute_code: New York Social Services Law § 224-a et seq.
laws.description: Provides paid leave for eligible employees. Currently up to 12 weeks at 67% pay for specified family and medical reasons.

duration.notes: Per 12-month period; pay at 67% of average weekly wage

other_requirements: Birth of child or bonding with newborn

duration.notes: Per 12-month period; pay at 67% of average weekly wage

laws.notes: Covers birth, bonding, adoption, foster care, and serious health conditions. Coordinated with FMLA.

laws.name: New York Domestic Violence Leave Law
laws.description: Employees who are victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking may take reasonable leave for legal, medical, or safety needs.

other_requirements: Victim of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking

laws.notes: Cannot be penalized for taking leave for legal proceedings, medical treatment, or safety planning related to domestic violence.

laws.name: New York Jury Duty Leave
laws.statute_code: New York Judiciary Law § 519, Labor Law § 740
laws.description: Employers cannot penalize employees for jury service or court-ordered appearance.

laws.name: New York Voting Leave
laws.description: Employees may take up to 2 hours off work to vote without loss of pay if they have insufficient time outside work hours.

other_requirements: Insufficient time outside work hours to vote

leave_types.notice_requirement: Notice before election day when practicable

laws.notes: Time is taken at beginning or end of work day at employer's discretion.

laws.name: New York Military Leave of Absence
laws.statute_code: New York Military Law § 242 et seq.
laws.description: Employees on military leave are entitled to job reinstatement and benefits continuation.
laws.notes: Protects rights of employees on active duty. Re-employment rights apply.
